job_description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

We're on a mission to democratize AI across our analytics team, and we need a trailblazing leader to helm this effort. As the Data Analytics and BI lead, you'll develop and execute a strategy to enable our analytics team members with AI capabilities, empowering them to drive business growth and deliver exceptional client value.

Skills and Experience

What you will do:
• Develop AI enablement strategy: Create a comprehensive plan to upskill and reskill our analytics team members with AI capabilities, aligning with business goals and objectives.
• Design and deliver AI training programs: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to design and deliver training programs that cover AI fundamentals, machine learning, and data science.
• Develop AI-powered tools and platforms: Lead the development of AI-powered tools and platforms that augment our analytics team's capabilities, driving efficiency, accuracy, and innovation.
• Foster a culture of AI adoption: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote AI adoption, provide guidance on AI best practices, and ensure seamless integration with existing workflows.
• Stay ahead of AI trends and advancements: Participate in industry conferences, research papers, and forums to maintain expertise and identify opportunities for innovation.

Role requirements:
• Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or related field.
• Experience: 10+ years of experience in AI engineering, with 5+ years in a leadership role.
• Technical expertise: Strong background in AI, machine learning, and software engineering, with experience in languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
• Knowledge of cloud-based AI platforms: Experience with cloud-based AI platforms such as Google Cloud AI Platform, Amazon SageMaker, or Microsoft Azure Machine Learning.
• Leadership skills: Proven track record of leading high-performing teams, with excellent communication, mentoring, and project management skills.
• Business acumen: Understanding of business operations, market trends, and the media industry.
• Please note the team will be prioritizing applicants who are already based in Singapore for this role.

Nice to have:
• Experience with media analytics: Familiarity with media measurement, data analytics, and advertising technology.
• Certifications in AI or machine learning: Certifications such as Certified Data Scientist or Certified Machine Learning Engineer.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities
• Provision cloud infrastructure as code across multiple environments: event bus, data lake, warehouse

capacity, and supporting services. Cost monitoring baked into every resource.
• Build a deterministic identity resolution service that examines incoming events, resolves identifiers across

source systems, assigns stable person IDs, and runs backward stitching to retroactively link anonymous

events to known persons. Implement SCD2 versioning and hysteresis to prevent identifier flapping.
• Build and maintain a warehouse model with bronze/silver/gold structure covering customer profiles, event

history, orders, products, inventory, consent, segments, and platform operational logs. Tests on every model.
• Implement a consent and suppression layer applied at every audience export — per person, per channel,

per purpose — with a global do-not-contact override.
• Deploy and configure an orchestration platform covering ingestion, identity resolution, transformations, and

activation, with schedules calibrated to source freshness tiers and Slack-integrated failure alerting.
• Build server-side conversion API integrations for major advertising platforms, using platform-specific

identifier hashing and deduplication keys consistent with client-side pixels.
• Implement right-to-erasure at the data layer: both soft delete (PII tombstoned, aggregates preserved) and

hard delete (rows removed). Monthly synthetic test verifies the pathway is functional.
• Configure observability, alert tiers, geo-redundant storage, and document disaster recovery procedures.

Microsoft Fabric, Azure (AKS, Event Hubs, ADLS Gen2, Functions, Key Vault, Synapse Link), dbt Core, Python, RudderStack OSS, Dagster, Dynamics 365 / Dataverse, networkx, Bicep, SQL

We are seeking a highly skilled BI Engineer to join our Data Engineering & Analytics team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and managing the Looker semantic layer, developing enterprise dashboards and reports, and enabling self-service business intelligence capabilities for business users.

You will work closely with Data Engineers and business stakeholders to ensure analytics datasets are scalable, performant, well-governed, and aligned with business objectives. This role requires strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Looker/LookML modeling, dashboard development, semantic modeling, and analytics best practices.

Key Responsibilities

1. Looker Semantic Modeling & Metrics Layer
• Design, develop, and maintain LookML models, including views, explores, and derived tables.
• Define and standardize business metrics, dimensions, calculations, and semantic definitions.
• Implement reusable measures, joins, and aggregate awareness to improve efficiency and scalability.
• Optimize semantic models for usability, performance, and governance.
• Collaborate with business and engineering stakeholders to align business logic and semantic definitions.

2. Dashboard & Reporting Development
• Design and build interactive Looker dashboards and reports to support business decision-making.
• Translate business requirements into intuitive and actionable data visualizations.
• Apply dashboard visualization best practices to improve storytelling and usability.
• Implement filters, drill-downs, and user-level access controls.
• Continuously improve dashboards based on stakeholder feedback and usage insights.

3. Self-Service BI Enablement
• Enable business users to explore trusted datasets through certified Looker explores.
• Reduce ad-hoc reporting dependency by building user-friendly semantic models.
• Provide training, demonstrations, and best-practice guidance to business users.
• Define governance guardrails to support scalable self-service analytics adoption.

4. SQL & Semantic Layer Development
• Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries for analytics use cases.
• Validate business logic, aggregations, and data accuracy.
• Work closely with Data Engineers to optimize datasets, tables, partitions, and data models.
• Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and data discrepancies.

5. Operations, Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
• Monitor dashboard performance, usage, and failures.
• Manage Looker content lifecycle from development to production.
• Implement content organization, governance, and access controls.
• Continuously improve analytics solutions using adoption and usage insights.

Requirements
• 5+ years of experience as a BI Engineer or similar analytics/BI role.
• Strong expertise in SQL (mandatory) and complex query optimization.
• Hands-on experience with Looker and LookML.
• Experience designing enterprise dashboards and semantic data models.
• Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, analytics modeling, and semantic layers.
• Experience working with BigQuery or other cloud data warehouse technologies.
• Ability to work closely with Data Engineers and business stakeholders.
• Experience in self-service BI enablement and analytics governance.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Experience with Power BI or other BI tools is a plus.

Job description

About the Role
SUMMARY ROLE

The Business Data Analytics Analyst / Professional supports the development of reports, datasets, dashboards, and analytical outputs that address business data and reporting requirements. The role works with senior analysts to translate business needs into data solutions by identifying relevant data sources, analyzing datasets, and generating insights that support operational monitoring and business decision-making. This position also contributes to improving data quality and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of analytical deliverables.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Support the collection and analysis of business data requirements, including business processes and business logic.

• Assist in identifying appropriate data sources, systems, and tools required to fulfill reporting and analytics needs.

• Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and data objects using proper BI platforms and solutions.

• Support the creation of 360-views of customer journey/experience and business interactions through integrated reporting solutions.

• Assist in automating operational processes, reports/analytical outputs, and data anomaly detection mechanisms while ensuring data accuracy.

• Perform data preparation activities including data extraction, cleaning, transformation, and integration from multiple un-/structured data sources.

• Support advanced analytics initiatives by preparing datasets and engineered features for analytical modeling.

• Support in development and operation of advanced analytics solutions of machine learning and AI models to turn data into value to address business needs and enrich BI capability

• Handle customer complaints and service requests (related to reporting and data analysis) within defined SLA while achieving highest level of quality and data accuracy in response.

• Conduct testing and validation to ensure data accuracy, completeness, reliability, and quality.

• Provide support by participating in cross functional teams of projects required data and analytics function.

• Contribute to maintaining data definitions, metadata documentation, and KPI catalog in alignment with the organization’s data governance framework.

• Maintain and create knowledge of organizational content in data, analytics techniques, BI tools, data development, and best practices.

• Support measurement of Zain performance across business domains to guide the process of Zain activities in co-ordination with relevant stakeholders, draw the SMART road map of the enterprise business intelligence unit, and align Zain and BI vision and missions

• Perform all the above-mentioned roles and responsibilities in compliance to the Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies and report any information/physical security breaches or incidents to the supervisor/manager immediately

• Be aware of, and adhere to, all environmental requirements as set by the statutory bodies in Kuwait, or by the published policies of Zain Group/Kuwait

Zain abides by fulfilling the occupational health and safety certificate requirements that establishes and maintains an OH&S management system that eliminate hazards and minimizes OH&S risks (including system deficiencies), take advantage of OH&S opportunities and addresses OH&S management system nonconformities associated with its activities

What We Need From You
SKILLS

• Ability to communicate, present and influence all levels of the organization

• Excellent verbal and written communications skills

• Proficiency in agile methodologies

• Knowledgeable in order management systems within the telecom industry

• Knowledge of support processes specific to the telecom industry

• Advanced Microsoft Office toolkit (Excel, pptx)

• Knowledge of development and development process.

• Data analytics and visual analytics (Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics)

• Competency in P-/SQL, Shell Script, Big Data, Python, R, Data Analysis, ETL is preferred

• Strong digital and analytical skillset

• Customer journey design experience

• Good negotiation, interpersonal and customer care skills

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to identify and frame key issues

• Excellent interpersonal organizational and project management skills

• Great people management skills and knowledge

High reliability in executing tasks within expected timeframe and to expected quality standards

Education

Computer Science, Information systems, or a related field

Bachelor’s Degree

We are Aire Guardians. At Abatement Technologies, we pride ourselves on our strong foundation built over three generations of family ownership. Our leaders operate with honesty and integrity, ensuring a positive impact on both our customers and employees. Our products and services are designed to meet the unique needs of contractors and facilities managers, ensuring safety, compliance, and efficiency.

We are committed to delivering exceptional value to our clients through our dedication to quality and customer service. As responsible corporate citizens, we are leaving a mark in our communities while embarking on an exciting journey of growth fueled by our commitment to excellence and innovation. Come journey with us and be part of a company that truly makes a difference!

Primary Purpose: The Business Intelligence & Reporting Analyst will play a crucial part in transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive key business decisions. The role is responsible for data analysis using visualization tools like Power BI to create interactive dashboards and reports that provide clear and concise information to stakeholders across the organization.

Essential Job Functions:

Business Intelligence and Reporting

• Develop a solid understanding of the company’s business functions and the metrics that drive their performance

• Collaborate with management to drive Business Intelligence (BI) adoption and foster a data-driven culture across the organization

• Develop and maintain complex data models, reports, and dashboards using BI tools

• Perform ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions and seek data-based insights for improvement.

• Monitor data quality and resolve any issues in collaboration with data owners

• Take corrective action and recommend or implement changes to reporting, as required

• Integrate new systems and upgrades into function operations, as needed

• Proactively identify key business opportunities, research and recommend enhancements / modifications

Data Acquisition and Preparation

• Gather, clean, and transform data from various sources (ERP databases, related APIs, spreadsheets, etc.) into a suitable format for analysis.

• Identify and address data quality issues, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.

Data Analysis and Modeling

• Conduct in-depth data analysis using statistical and analytical techniques.

• Perform data mining and predictive modeling to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.

Dashboard and Report Development

• Utilize best practices in data visualization to effectively communicate insights to stakeholders.

• Integrate data with other business applications and systems.

• Ability to work with large amounts of data and build platforms.

Stakeholder Communication and Collaboration

• Collaborate with business users to understand their data needs and requirements.

• Translate complex data into clear and concise business insights.

• Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.

• Training end-users on new queries, reports and dashboards.

Sales and Production Data

• Support monthly, quarterly, and annual sales management reporting to stakeholders.

• Support the detailed development of the annual operating plan, sales forecasts, and strategic plans, while playing a key role in annual budget and strategic planning processes.

• Provide expertise on business processes and solutions.

• Support Production team to discuss variance analysis, material items, and key issues.

• Assist the Sales department with pricing review and margin analysis.

People & Culture

• Model Abatement’s values in all that you do and hold others accountable in maintaining the integrity of them.

• Champion, influence, embrace and motivate change, with a strategic mindset for continuous improvement and scalability.

• Commitment to Health and Safety, consistently following all policies/rules and procedures.

Perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned by Company management. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, or working conditions.

Supervisory Responsibility: None

Education and Work Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Analytics, Information Systems, Business, Finance, or a related field.

• Strong proficiency in data visualization skills such as Power BI.

• Experience with data warehousing concepts and technologies.

• Experience with data mining and predictive modeling techniques, an asset.

• Proficiency in SQL and other data query languages.

• Demonstrated experience in handling large data sets.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage a fluctuating workload and set priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience with Epicor Kinetic, an asset.

• Exhibits a high level of integrity, mutual respect, and employee teamwork always.

• Ability to make decisions, participate and help facilitate organizational change.

• Demonstrates a strong commitment to meeting or exceeding company expectations, goals and objectives.

• Demonstrates sound business judgment.

• Ability to keep Company information in strict confidence and always adhere to Company policies and procedures.

• Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

Work is performed at a desk in a comfortable office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment such as a computer, photocopier, telephone. Walking short distances and spending most of the time in front of a computer screen. Some climbing of stairs may be required. Moderate level of stress in terms of analyzing data, presenting, and meeting deadlines.

• The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We offer a full set of benefits including:

• Company paid benefits program which includes: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Employee Assistance Program

• Enhanced vacation and paid time off

• RRSP match program

• Bi-annual bonus, subject to company approval

Abatement Technologies welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Job Description
End-to-end BI delivery
• Deliver BI solutions from discovery and requirements through to build, testing, deployment, stakeholder enablement, and continuous improvement.

• Ensure deliverables are reliable, well-documented, and fit-for-purpose for decision-making.

Data modelling and engineering
• Support the design and development of data structures for analytics (e.g., staging models, dimensional models, semantic layers).

• Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and relevant integration/orchestration tools (batch and, where needed, near real-time).

• Validate and reconcile data across multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.

Data integration across systems
• Support interoperability and data flows between enterprise systems (e.g., student information systems such as student system HRMS, and analytics platforms).

• Map and integrate data from databases, APIs, and operational applications into analytics-ready datasets.

BI reporting, analytics, and visualisation (Power BI)
• Create and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI that track operational KPIs such as:

*enrolment, retention, withdrawals
*resource utilisation
*performance drivers and trends

• Build reusable datasets/semantic models that support consistent KPI definitions and reporting.

• Apply visualisation best practices and ensure outputs are actionable for business users.

BI database operations support
• Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining BI data stores (cloud and/or on-prem).

• Support access provisioning and controls to ensure secure and appropriate permission levels.

• Maintain runbooks, data dictionaries, and technical documentation for BI assets.

Stakeholder management and requirements translation
• Gather requirements, clarify objectives and responsibilities, and translate business needs into clear BI specifications.

• Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and changes in a timely and professional manner.

Governance, change management, and adoption
• Apply change management practices to BI deliverables (dashboards, datasets, pipelines), including versioning and controlled releases.

• Prepare communications, release notes, and guidance to support stakeholder adoption.

• Support alignment of BI outputs with business priorities, risk considerations, and governance expectations.

Security and compliance alignment
• Embed security controls in BI workflows (least privilege, secure access, data handling practices).

• Contribute to secure-by-design thinking for data integration and analytics solutions.

Project management support
• Support planning and execution of medium-scale BI initiatives (e.g., dashboard rollouts, new dataset releases, predictive model pilots).

• Track milestones and deliverables and coordinate stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.

Emerging technology evaluation (as applicable)
• Contribute to evaluating emerging analytics capabilities (e.g., ML platforms, LLM-enabled analytics features) to improve BI processes, with appropriate governance and controls.

• Relevant Qualification in IT, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Power BI proficiency (dashboard creation, data modelling concepts, KPI reporting)

• Solid foundation in SQL (joins, aggregations, data validation; familiarity with modelling concepts).

• Understanding of BI concepts (KPIs, reporting workflows, visualisation practices, data quality).

• Good problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and willingness to learn across domains.

• Clear communication and documentation skills.

Location: Muscat, Oman

Company: Hairun Technology

About Us

Hairun Technology is a leading provider of digital and financial technology solutions, committed to innovation, efficiency, and data-driven decision-making. With a strong presence in Oman, we empower businesses to harness the power of analytics and intelligent systems. To strengthen our finance and analytics team in Muscat, we are seeking a skilled Business Intelligence (Finance) Specialist to design, manage, and optimize BI solutions that support strategic financial growth.
Role Overview The Business Intelligence (Finance) Specialist will be responsible for developing financial dashboards, managing data models, and delivering actionable insights to senior leadership. This role requires strong technical expertise, financial acumen, and the ability to translate complex data into clear strategies.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and maintain BI dashboards and reports for financial performance tracking.

• Develop and optimize financial data models to support forecasting and planning.

• Collaborate with finance, IT, and operations teams to ensure data accuracy.

• Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Fluency in English; Arabic is a strong advantage.

Why Join Us?

• Be part of a respected technology company shaping financial intelligence in Oman.

• Work on high-impact projects with regional and international exposure.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

• Collaborative, innovative, and data-driven work culture.

Work Location: In person

job_description:
HSB Canada, part of Munich Re, is Canada's premier engineering-driven specialty insurer and provider of inspection, engineering and technology services that set the standard for excellence in the market. Our constantly evolving offerings lead to the market in cyber, equipment breakdown, renewable energy, technology services, engineering based risk management and inspection services. We bring technical expertise to help our clients stay ahead of complex, emerging, and technology-based risks. We dare to think big and we are continuously innovating on behalf of our clients. We recognize Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging as key priorities and a culture that welcomes different thoughts and opinions.

HSB is much more! It’s insurance. Engineering. Technology. To learn more about us, please visit www.hsb.ca

Primary Objectives:

The Business Intelligence Analyst independently designs, develops, and delivers advanced analytics and data visualization solutions that support underwriting, claims, pricing, actuarial, and policy operations. The role applies strong BI, analytics, and data engineering capabilities to transform complex data into actionable insights that drive informed business decisions and measurable performance improvements.

Job Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and deploy advanced dashboards and analytical reports using Power BI, emphasizing data storytelling and actionable insights.

• Function as a technical analytics resource within the Data & Analytics function, exercising independent judgment on matters of significance.

• Ensure analytics initiatives deliver measurable business value aligned to stakeholder KPIs and strategic objectives.

• Perform advanced analytics including segmentation, cohort, root-cause, impact, and statistical significance analysis.

• Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric and mixed data environments.

• Translate complex technical outputs into clear insights and recommendations for business partners and senior leadership.

• Support underwriting, pricing, actuarial, and policy teams with analytics and decision support.

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve portfolio performance, operational efficiency, and analytics best practices.

• Mentor other analysts and contribute to process, quality, and analytics maturity improvements.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Information Sciences, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related fields

• 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or data visualization roles

• Experience delivering value-adding analytics solutions, ideally within P&C insurance or financial services

• Strong awareness of insurance portfolio performance, underwriting rules, rating factors, and decision engines preferred

• Master’s degree or professional insurance designation (e.g., CIP) is an asset

• Intermediate to advanced experience designing, developing, and deploying Power BI dashboards, including DAX and Power Query

• Intermediate to advanced experience with Python and/or R for analytics and data processing is an asset

• Strong SQL skills, including database design, stored procedures, and analytical querying

• Intermediate to advanced experience with ETL and data preparation processes across mixed environments

• Intermediate Working knowledge of Azure data and analytics services, including Databricks

• Intermediate to advanced Excel proficiency; familiarity with Microsoft Office tools for executive communication

• Advanced analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to statistical rigor

• Strong ability to communicate complex data insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Collaborative collaborator with the ability to work independently and take ownership

• Curious, innovative mindset with openness to new analytical approaches and technologies

Company Benefits:

Together, we engage with everything we have and are, to help humankind act braver and better. Go further with HSB.

We are pleased to offer our employees great benefits and resources to support their mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. These include:

• An engaging and collaborative environment that promotes continuous learning and development

• A hybrid work environment that combines weekly in-office and remote days

• A great compensation package including an annual company bonus

• Competitive company-paid flexible health and dental benefits, starting on your first day

• Flexible dollars provided by the company to put towards a Health Spending Account and/or Wellness Spending Account

• Wellness program with tools and resources supporting your mental, physical, and financial wellbeing – on and off the job

• Participation in the DC Pension Plan with a progressive employer contribution scale based on tenure starting at 4%, plus optional company match in the RRSP plan

• Generous time off including vacation, personal days, unplanned time, Statutory Holidays and company-wide early closure half-days

• Learning and development programs and resources, including unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, Education Assistance Program, and reimbursement for professional fees

• Employee Referral Program and Recognition Program

Our base salary range for this role is between $81,720 and $95,340 per year, plus an opportunity for an annual company bonus based upon a percentage of eligible pay. The salary estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for candidates hired in this position. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have, and comparison to internal equity.

This role is located in our Toronto office on 390 Bay St, and we operate in a hybrid work model. This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

We do not use AI in our recruitment process - applications are reviewed by our team to ensure a fair and personalized experience.

HSB Canada is committed to providing a work environment that is inclusive and free of employment barriers and discrimination. Accommodations will be made for qualified applicants with a disability throughout the recruitment process. If you receive a request for an interview and you have a disability which will require an accommodation to support your participation, please consult with Human Resources or contact hr@hsb.ca as soon as practical so that suitable accommodations can be arranged.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected for interview will be contacted.

Job Description:

The opportunity:

As part of the Hub APMEA Strategy organization, this role enables data-driven strategic decision-making by transforming internal and external data into clear insights that support Hitachi Energy’s mid- to long-term growth ambitions across the APMEA region.

How you’ll make an impact:

• Provide analytical support to Hub and BU strategy development, including growth initiatives, portfolio prioritization, and market entry/expansion topics.

• Support mid-term strategic planning, annual planning, and strategic reviews with data-driven insights and structured analysis. Develop business cases, scenario analyses, and what-if models to support leadership decision-making.

• Drive analysis and insight for monthly and ad-hoc Hub/BU performance discussions, linking financial, commercial, and market indicators to strategic objectives.

• Identify trends, risks, and opportunities impacting Hub performance and translate them into executive-ready insights.

• Support alignment between strategy, marketing priorities, and commercial execution through analytical storytelling. Maintain a high-level view of market and competitor dynamics to provide strategic context for planning and decision-making.

• Produce periodic intelligence summaries focused on implications for strategy rather than detailed competitive tracking or pricing execution.

• Provide strategic and analytical in leadership discussions and reviews. Deliver insights derived from data analysis along with reporting & Stakeholder Collaboration.

• Develop clear, executive-ready dashboards, reports, and presentations using Power BI, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

• Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

• Proven proficiency with at least one major BI tool (Microsoft Power BI, Tableau) for dashboard and report development

• SQL skills for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis

##

## Micron drives the future of memory and semiconductor technology, helping the world transform information into intelligence. The Engineering Tool Development (ETD) team develops innovative analytic and automation solutions that solve some of the most complex manufacturing challenges in the semiconductor industry.

## We are seeking a highly motivated Business Analyst who is excited about semiconductors, packaging technologies, and data driven problem solving. In this role, you will help translate business needs into actionable requirements, support image analysis solution development, and collaborate with engineers across global teams.

##

## Role Overview

## As a Business Analyst for the ETD team, you will partner with engineers, data scientists, and program managers to support development of advanced imaging, metrology, and data analytics solutions. Your work will help streamline manufacturing flows, enhance defect detection and classification, and enable next generation packaging technologies.

##

## Key Responsibilities

## Stakeholder & Requirements Support

* ## Collaborate with image processing engineers, packaging SMEs, and operations teams to understand business challenges and translate them into clear problem statements and requirements.

* ## Support intake, scoping, and prioritization of new project requests.

## Data & Image Analytics Collaboration

* ## Partner with technical teams to define data needs, evaluate feasibility, and help structure image processing focused use cases.

* ## Assist in documenting assumptions, constraints, and expected business value.

## Project Coordination

* ## Help track project milestones, dependencies, and deliverables across cross functional teams.

* ## Contribute to transition planning for solutions moving from prototype to production deployment.

## Communication & Documentation

* ## Produce clear and concise documentation, including requirement summaries, feasibility notes, user guides, and status updates.

* ## Communicate findings and recommendations to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

* ## Support incident follow‑up and cross‑team communication for manufacturing‑impacting issues by documenting problem statements, decisions, and system impacts when needed.

##

## Required Qualifications

* ## Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Analytics, Engineering Management, or a related field.

* ## 3+ years experience in semiconductor industry with understanding of package development

* ## Experience with Python, SQL, or data analysis tools.

* ## Exposure to image analytics, machine learning, optics, or semiconductor manufacturing concepts.

* ## Strong analytical and problem solving skills with an ability to break down complex processes or datasets.

* ## Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* ## Ability to work cross-functionally with diverse, global teams.

* ## Highly organized with the ability to handle multiple tasks in a dynamic environment.

* ## Familiarity with project coordination, requirements analysis, or technical documentation.

At Quinte Health, our four hospitals unite under the core values of Imagine It’s You, Value Everyone, We All Make a Difference, and Stronger Together. We work as one team to enhance lives, improve access to high-quality care, and build healthier communities—right where people need it most.

Quinte Health’s four hospitals are the heart of our communities, delivering exceptional care close to home. As one unified team, we’re passionate about improving lives and expanding access to high-quality healthcare. Our staff, physicians, and volunteers don’t just work here—we live, grow, and thrive here. If you’re compassionate and driven, we have exciting opportunities across our hospitals. Join us and make a real impact!

Position Summary

The Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Knowledge Management team (ABIKM) provides analytical support to programs/services across Quinte Health, as well as key strategic, quality, performance, and financial initiatives. The team is composed of experienced professionals who support the organization’s data needs, including reporting, visualization, analysis, and database management.

Quinte Health is seeking a motivated and analytically driven individual to join the Analytics, Business Intelligence and Knowledge Management (ABIKM) team in a temporary full-time capacity. This role will support clinical, operational, and strategic decision-making through advanced analytics, data exploration, and insight generation.

The successful candidate will work with complex healthcare data to identify trends, support performance improvement initiatives, and contribute to the organization’s evolving data and analytics environment. The role is well-suited to candidates with education or experience in data science, statistics, epidemiology, analytics, computer science, health informatics, or related disciplines who are interested in applying analytical methods in a healthcare setting.

This role provides an opportunity for a dynamic individual to contribute to the analytical aspects of quality improvement, innovation, collaboration and data-informed decision-making in support of exceptional patient care across the Quinte region.

Why join Quinte Health?

This role offers an opportunity to:

• Apply analytical skills to meaningful healthcare challenges.

• Gain experience working with complex real-world healthcare data.

• Contribute to initiatives that support patient care and operational improvement.

• Work in a collaborative and evolving analytics environment.

• Develop practical experience in healthcare analytics and data science.

Required

• Undergraduate degree in a relevant field (Data Science, Epidemiology, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Health Informatics, Biostatistics, Public Health, Engineering, Business Analytics, Science, etc.).

• Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

• Experience working in a decision support, analytics, or database management environment.

• Understanding of statistical and analytical concepts.

• Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.

• Ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred

Preference may be given to candidates with experience or demonstrated interest in:

• Related co-op, internship, research or practical project experience is considered an asset.

• Familiarity with SQL and/or programming languages such as Python or R is considered an asset.

• Experience with data visualization or reporting tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is an asset.

• Healthcare analytics or health system performance measurement

• Data science or predictive analytics methodologies

• Applied research or evaluation work

• Quality improvement and operational analysis

• Applied healthcare analytics, population health, epidemiology, or statistical modeling

Duties

• Perform data analysis to support clinical, operational, and organizational priorities – with a primary focus on emergency department performance and flow.

• Assist with advanced analytics activities, including statistical analysis, trend analysis and forecasting, and predictive or exploratory analytics.

• Support the development of reports, dashboards, and analytical products.

• Interpret and communicate findings in a clear and actionable manner.

• Work with large and complex datasets from multiple healthcare systems.

• Identify data quality issues, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

• Collaborate with Data Analysts and technical staff to support ongoing analytics initiatives.

• Contribute to special projects related to performance measurement, patient flow, quality improvement, and operational planning.

• Engage in collaborative initiatives with key hospital departments such as IT, Finance, Clinical Informatics.

• Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing initiatives to foster continuous learning within the team.

• Other duties as assigned.

Equal Opportunity

What We'll Bring:

We Are TransUnion:

TransUnion is a major credit reference agency, and we offer specialist services in fraud, identity and risk management, automated decisioning and demographics. We support organisations across a variety of sectors including finance, retail, telecommunications, utilities, gaming, government and insurance.

What You'll Bring:

We're looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our growing team.

In this fast‑paced role, with access to a vast range of data sets, you'll work within the wider Business Intelligence team to develop and deliver effective reports and dashboards-on time and aligned to business priorities-empowering our customers to make data‑driven decisions.

Day to Day You'll Be:

Developing reports and dashboards that streamline manual processes and automate key business functions.

Using ETL processes to transform data into clean, reportable formats.

Leveraging our data warehouses to provide data‑driven insights that support informed business decisions.

Presenting regular updates on the development and performance of key organisational metrics and KPIs.

Conducting peer reviews to ensure reports and dashboards align with stakeholder needs and meet departmental quality standards.

Supporting the transition of user‑created data visualisation solutions into enterprise‑standard platforms.

Adhering to team procedures and best practices-including coding and build standards-to deliver high‑readability, maintainable outputs.

Refining and optimising existing data workflows to improve efficiency, resilience, and readiness for future enhancements.

Essential Skills & Experience:

Degree‑level education or equivalent professional experience.

Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.

Highly organised self‑starter with excellent attention to detail.

Understanding of data quality principles.

Hands‑on experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio).

Experience designing and developing reports and dashboards.

High proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Desirable Skills & Experience:

SQL proficiency for querying and manipulating large datasets.

Knowledge and experience of using of ETL platforms (e.g., Alteryx).

Familiarity with modern development practices, including Agile methodologies, source control, and coding standards.

Impact You'll Make:

What's In It For you?

At TransUnion you will be joining a friendly, forward thinking global business.

As well as an excellent salary and bonus scheme or commission scheme (if joining our sales teams) our benefits package comes with:

26 days' annual leave + bank holidays (increasing with service)

Global paid wellness days off + a bonus day off to celebrate your birthday

A generous contributory pension scheme + access to the TransUnion Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Private health care + a variety of physical, mental and financial fitness wellbeing programmes such as access to mindfulness tools

Access to our diversity forums and communities so you can get involved in causes close to your heart

TransUnion - a place to grow:

If there's something on the list of essential / desirable skills that you can't quite tick off, don't let that put you off applying. We are open to exploring training and development opportunities for the right candidate to ensure you are successful.

We know imposter syndrome is real, lets confront it so we can continue to grow and thrive together

Flexibility at TU:

We recognise that our people need the freedom to balance their day-to-day lives with their work. This is why we've set out to create inclusive and flexible policies and practices for you to accommodate all your responsibilities and needs: children, family and beyond. If the role is advertised as full time, don't let this stop you from applying. Let us know if you're looking for a part time or flexible working arrangement and we can discuss this with you.

Additional support:

At TransUnion, we're committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all individual's talents and perspectives are valued. When you apply for a position with us, you're not just joining a team, you're becoming part of a community that celebrates differences and embraces equality. We understand that everyone has different needs, which is why we offer a range of reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments to help you through the application process or to attend an interview with us by contacting (url removed)

Interview & Hiring Process:

Most of our recruitment processes are virtual, so you'll get to know our hiring managers and teams over the phone and through video. If we need you to attend a physical in person interview your recruiter will inform you of this.

We do not accept any unsolicited CV's from recruitment agencies. If you are a recruitment agency on our PSL our talent team will contact you directly should we require any assistance.

(url removed) is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Join OneAdvanced

This is a client-facing BI role where you’ll take requirements, build solutions, and deliver them directly to customers. You’ll work closely with legal teams, legal operations, and technology stakeholders to understand how they operate and where data and automation can make a real difference.

The focus is on turning complex or manual processes into clear, usable insights and efficient workflows. You’ll be involved from the early conversations through to delivery, helping clients improve reporting, streamline approvals, and make better decisions using Power BI and Power Automate.

This is a hybrid role based from our Birmingham HQ, with flexible working in place and an expectation to be in the office when needed, typically on a weekly basis.

What You Will Do

You will work end-to-end with clients, shaping requirements and delivering impactful BI and automation solutions.

• Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for client delivery

• Design data models, DAX measures, and transformations for scalable, accurate reporting

• Develop Power Automate workflows to streamline processes and approvals

• Translate business needs into practical BI and automation solutions

• Ensure data is secure, compliant, and aligned with governance standards

• Document solutions clearly and support ongoing improvements

What You Will Have

Please note, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK at the time of application.

You are confident working with stakeholders and delivering solutions, not just building reports.

• Strong experience as a BI Developer or BI Consultant

• Advanced Power BI skills including data modelling, DAX, and Power Query

• Hands-on experience with Power Automate and workflow design

• Experience working with stakeholders and gathering requirements

• Background in a regulated environment such as legal, finance, or similar

Nice to have

• Experience working with legal systems or legal teams

• SQL and relational database knowledge

• Exposure to Microsoft 365 integrations

#LI-RL1

What We Do For You

Wellbeing that means something

• 26 days’ holiday + bank holidays (and the option to buy more) plus 1 paid volunteering day every year

• Exceptional family leave, 26 weeks fully paid maternity/adoption, 4 weeks fully paid paternity, 22 weeks fully paid shared parental leave, plus 5 days paid bereavement leave

• Robust sick pay of up to 13 weeks full pay + 13 weeks half pay

• 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support

• Private medical insurance for everyone, no medical-history exclusions

Financial benefits that have your back

• Performance-based rewards tailored to your role, from company-wide bonuses to OTE and commission structures

• Income protection: up to 75% salary for 5 years if you ever need it

Grow your career with us

• SkillsHub learning platform with leadership pathways, future-manager training, and a huge online library

• Access to external training and apprenticeships

Making a Difference

• MatchIt! Fundraise for a cause close to your heart and OneAdvanced will match part of the funding

• Pennies from Heaven donate the pennies from your pay check to help make a difference without lifting a finger

Plus plenty other flexible benefits to suit your lifestyle on our RewardHub, including:

• ULEV car scheme with 1,000+ models

• Dental insurance, Health Cash Plan, Critical Illness Cover, Partner Life Cover

Who We Are

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.

Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

Learn more at www.oneadvanced.com

POSITION: Business Intelligence Engineer
STATUS: Full-Time, Hybrid
LOCATION: Kohl & Frisch Limited (Concord, ON)
REPORTS TO: Manager, IT Business Intelligence Services
DEPARTMENT: IT Systems & Development

Founded in 1916, Kohl & Frisch Limited has a solid reputation in the healthcare industry that distinguishes it as the only national, Canadian-owned and operated wholesale distributor. A family-owned company, it is one of Canada's leading national distributors and is the essential link between pharmaceutical manufacturers and healthcare providers. Kohl & Frisch is fully equipped to service large chain retailers, independent pharmacies, clinics, and hospitals for all their Rx, OTC, home healthcare, and front shop needs.

Primary Role of This Position
The Business Intelligence Engineer is responsible for supporting the stability of our current reporting landscape while helping design the next generation of data and reporting solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to work with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Power Automate in a dynamic, collaborative, and forwardthinking environment.Major Responsibilities
• Learn and navigate the company's evolving data landscape, including legacy SSRS, new ERP data structures, and Microsoft Fabric components.
• Develop data flows, Power BI dashboards and reports for internal and external stakeholders.
• Troubleshoot data issues, investigate root causes, and drive resolution across systems and data sources.
• Support business teams with adhoc data requests, report administration, and data validation.
• Provide proactive oversight of scheduled reporting workflows, ensuring outputs are complete, accurate, and uninterrupted.
• Ensure smooth and timely generation, distribution, and quality of operational and analytical reports.
• Follow team processes, develop standards, and best practices for BI and data engineering.

Education and Experience
• Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline
• 3+ years experience as a BI Engineer in modern Microsoft BI and analytics environments
• Strong TSQL skills and comfort working with complex relational datasets.
• Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and DataFramebased processing frameworks.
• Experience using Power Automate to build automated workflows and integrations.
• Solid experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query).
• Experience with Gitbased DevOps workflows.
• Familiarity with medallion data architecture.
• Understanding of data governance, security standards, and best practices.
• Supply chain industry data experience is an asset.
• Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals or Data Engineering certification is an asset.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics data models is an asset.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Qualifications
• A problemsolver who enjoys untangling complex data challenges.
• A selfstarter who thrives in a fastpaced, evolving environment with shifting data structures.
• Passionate about efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement in data engineering and reporting.
• A collaborative team player who values knowledge sharing and learning from others.

What's in it for you?
This position offers a salary range of $85,000 - $105,000, exclusive of discretionary bonus eligibility and our full benefits package. The final salary offered to the selected candidate will be determined by factors including location, relevant experience, skill level and education.

Additional Compensation (if applicable):
• Bonus or commission structure
• Pension Plan (eligibility after 18 months service)

Benefits:
• Health, dental, vision from day 1
• Personal Days
• Employee Assistance Program
• Opportunity for Professional Development
• Wellness programs
• Vacation Pay
• Exclusive memberships and discounts

How to Apply

If you are interested in applying, please submit a resume and any other relevant documentation and by April 17, 2026 to: recruitment@kohlandfrisch.com.

Please ensure you specify the job title, Business Intelligence Engineer in the subject line of your email.

As part of our recruitment process we may use AI for initial screening and assisting in evaluating candidate qualifications. All final hiring decisions will be made by our recruitment team.

Kohl & Frisch would like to thank all applicants for their interest. All applicants who received interviews will receive an update on their application status within 45 days of applying. We value your interest in joining our team and strive to provide a timely, transparent hiring experience.

Kohl & Frisch Limited welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and provides accommodations upon request for candidates taking part in the selection process.

job_description:
The Reporting, Insights & Analytics team is on a mission to harness the power of data to guide strategic decisions and improve business operations. Reporting directly into our Chief Data Office, this team collaborates closely with C-Suite executives and Business Unit leaders to develop products, refine processes, and generate actionable insights on a global scale.

As a member of this team, you will play a key role in delivering scalable, high-quality business intelligence solutions that power decision-making across Sales & Pipeline, Engagement Economics, Capacity Planning, and other core operational areas. You will contribute to the development of reports, dashboards, and data models that help leadership monitor performance against Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and drive continuous improvement.

This role requires strong analytical thinking, foundational BI engineering skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders. It is ideal for someone who is passionate about data, eager to grow within a modern cloud data environment, and motivated to contribute to enterprise-wide analytics transformation.

Role Overview

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will support the design, development, and optimization of enterprise reporting and analytics solutions within Kroll’s Azure-based data ecosystem.

You will work closely with senior BI engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into intuitive dashboards and well-structured semantic models. This role provides hands-on exposure to Power BI development, data modeling best practices, and structured Agile delivery.

You will contribute to building reliable, scalable, and trusted reporting assets that enable leadership to make confident, data-driven decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the development and ongoing enhancement of Power BI dashboards and reporting products aligned to business priorities, including clear KPI definitions and decision-oriented storytelling.
• Design, build, and maintain Power BI semantic models using dimensional modeling best practices (e.g., star schema) to improve performance, usability, and consistency across reports.
• Develop reusable, well-documented DAX measures (including time intelligence patterns where appropriate) and optimize calculations and model design to ensure responsive, scalable reporting experiences.
• Perform data shaping and transformation using Power Query (M) with an emphasis on maintainability and repeatability of data preparation steps.
• Use SQL to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise systems; partner with upstream teams to resolve data quality issues and reconcile metrics.
• Collaborate with Data Engineers to understand upstream pipelines and data products, provide reporting requirements, and influence data structures that best support analytics and semantic modeling.
• Implement and support governed access patterns, including Row-Level Security (RLS) where required, and partner with platform/tenant stakeholders to ensure the right balance of access and control.
• Manage operational reliability of published assets (refresh requirements, dependencies, and impact), using platform capabilities such as endorsement, lineage, and refresh options (including incremental refresh where appropriate).
• Contribute to BI engineering standards: workspace organization, naming conventions, documentation, and lifecycle practices (dev/test/prod promotion, controlled releases, versioning), consistent with enterprise lifecycle management approaches.
• Document KPI logic, data definitions, semantic model design decisions, and report usage considerations to support governance, transparency, and auditability (not just “how,” but “why”).
• Partner directly with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate business questions into analytic specifications, and communicate tradeoffs clearly; Kroll job postings emphasize the importance of translating technical details into business terms and proactively surfacing issues before they reach downstream consumers.
• Participate in Agile delivery routines (planning, refinement, and iterative delivery) and proactively manage your workstream to deliver high-quality outcomes on time.
• Mentor or support the development of more junior analysts/report developers through reviews, pairing, and reusable assets, consistent with enterprise enablement practices

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Reporting, or a related data-focused role, with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end BI deliverables (requirements → model/report build → validation → release → iteration).
• Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including semantic model design, DAX, Power Query, visualization, and management/security
• Strong SQL skills and comfort working with relational data structures; ability to validate metrics and troubleshoot discrepancies.
• Solid understanding of dimensional modeling principles (facts/dimensions, star schema) and how model design impacts performance and usability in Power BI.
• Experience working in or alongside a cloud-based data platform environment (Azure preferred); familiarity with common Azure analytics components is a plus (ex. Data Factory, Synapse, and Data Lake.)
• Practical knowledge of data governance fundamentals (definitions, documentation, lineage/impact awareness) and a commitment to accurate, trusted reporting.
• Experience with CI/CD processes for Business Intelligences is a plus (ex. Deployment pipelines, Git)
• Strong analytical problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Business Intelligence Engineer III
At Preferred Travel Group, we care deeply about our people, nurture independence, and celebrate individuality.
Family values inspire us, and we believe that change creates opportunity.
We are committed listeners and deliberate storytellers in hospitality.
We engineer potential, foster trust, and co-create brighter futures.
Our culture values collaboration, adaptability, and precisionqualities essential to every role.
We are forever curious, guided by the Pineapple as our global symbol of hospitality.
We believe the business of hospitality is borderless, and we proudly embrace that spirit every day.

We believe that every team member brings unique strengths to the table, and we're committed to creating an environment where those strengths can thrive.

Position Summary
We are seeking an analytical, solution-orientated, experienced Business Intelligence Engineer III.
You will be responsible for developing and maintaining the company's reporting and analytics solutions, ensuring stakeholder access to accurate, optimally presented data for actionable insights.
This role is the primary business-facing representative of the data team and is expected to have expert knowledge of our data, including its structure, usage, and business meaning.
Under the general supervision of the department director, the BI Engineer works closely with other engineers in the Data and QA teams and frequently interacts with end users and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, build, and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations
• Write optimized queries to support complex business analysis in reports and ad-hoc queries
• Ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance of all reports and analytics solutions
• Drive development of advanced analytics capabilities with machine learning and AI
• Act as primary point of contact for business users regarding reporting and data inquiries
• Conduct trainings and office hours to improve self-service analytics adoption and outcomes
• Gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into technical solutions
• Respond to user tickets and bug reports in a timely manner
• Assist in designing and optimizing data models for reporting and analytics purposes
• Work with Data Engineers to define and improve data processes that serve reporting needs
• Participate in troubleshooting and performance tuning of upstream data storage and processing
• Monitor and maintain the performance and availability of all reports and analytics solutions
• Troubleshoot and resolve reporting-related issues, ensuring minimal downtime for end users
• Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency across the data environment
• Enforce data governance policy
• Manage and prioritize work in ticketing system
• Maintain regular communication in stand-ups and stakeholder meetings
• Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices and high-quality deliverables
• Contribute to technical documentation for processes, tools, and workflows
• Mentor other team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on best practices
• Take ownership of complex projects, ensure timely delivery of solutions that meet requirements
• Advocate for adoption and usage of our tools and new technologies across the company
Required Experience/Qualifications
This role is classified as a senior-level (Tier III) position and requires substantial prior experience in business intelligence and analytics, in addition to:

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Business Analytics, Information Systems, or other relevant degree/related field, or equivalent professional experience
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage non-technical stakeholders effectively
• Expert knowledge of reporting/data visualization tools (Power BI)
• Expert knowledge of one or more relevant languages (DAX, SQL, Python, R)
• Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and ETL best practices
• Experience with version control systems and best practices (Git, GitHub)
• Knowledge of machine learning and AI concepts and their applications to business intelligence
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on complex tasks
Typical Behaviors & Working Style
The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following behavioral traits:

• Preference for varied tasks or projects.
Comfortable balancing multiple simultaneous projects in a fast-paced environment.

• Focus is on technical and analytical work.
Must adhere to established standards and guidelines, troubleshooting problems based on expert knowledge.

• Needs to make decisive, quick decisions within a pre-defined span of control, adhering to accepted quality standards, policies, and procedures.
Will also train others to make and uphold accurate decisions.

• Communicates based on the task or technical needs at hand, defining clear team roles.
Minimal collaboration is required, although they must prioritize specific tasks or problems.

• Leads according to specialty or expertise.
Will act with conviction to ensure quality standards, rarely delegating.
When delegation is required, follow up will be close.

Preferred Working Environment & Job Characteristics
This role is best suited to someone who thrives in a:

• Business facing analytics environment, acting as the primary point of contact for reporting and data insights.

• High standards, accuracy driven setting, where data quality, reliability, and governance are critical.

• Fast paced, multi priority workload, balancing reporting development, stakeholder reques.

We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to help transform complex data into actionable insights that drive business performance and improve customer experiences across our Canada segment businesses (Group Benefits, Affinity, IIC, and Bank).

The role offers the opportunity to solve complex business problems while strengthening both analytical depth and executive‑level storytelling.

• Translate business needs into clear objectives, KPIs, and reporting solutions that support strategic and operational decision‑making
• Design, build, and maintain enterprise‑grade dashboards and reports using BI and visualization tools such as PowerBI
• Proactively identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within large, complex datasets and communicate findings to senior stakeholders

Job Description

Purpose of the role

Ensure the PMIS solution becomes operationally successful by protecting SAP as the system of record, ensuring correct financial integration, preventing license and scope surprises, and enabling clean reconciliation and acceptance across OpCos and corporate oversight.

Key responsibilities

• SAP integration & data correctness (primary)

• Own the SAP-facing integration workstream end-to-end

• Define and validate integration objects (budgets, commitments, actuals, payments, vendor data as applicable)

• Approve interface method and design (API/IDoc/OData/middleware) with IT Apps

• Define reconciliation rules (what must match, tolerances, timing, cutoff, and error handling)

• Produce/validate an Interface Register (object, owner, frequency, triggers, payload, validation rules, error handling, logging)

• Finance process fit & configuration assurance

• Validate that PMIS workflows align with SAP financial controls and processes

• WBS structure and coding governance compatibility

• Cost object mapping and reporting hierarchies

• Budget control points and approval logic alignment

• Review vendor functional design documents and confirm they are buildable without rework

• UAT/SIT readiness + acceptance gates

• Design the SAP-relevant SIT/UAT test strategy

• Test scenarios that mirror real lifecycle events (budget changes, commitments, invoices/payments, revisions, cancellations)

• Define UAT entry/exit criteria and “definition of done” for SAP integration

• Lead defect triage for SAP-facing issues

Client introduction

Our client is an established global supply chain and product‑development business serving international retail and consumer brands. Headquartered in Singapore with operations across multiple markets, they manage the full supply chain – from design and product development through to quality, compliance and delivery – across a range of consumer and home‑product categories. As reporting becomes increasingly central to how senior management, finance, procurement and quality teams make decisions, they are now building out their Business Intelligence capability locally in Singapore.

They are hiring a newly created permanent role of a Business Intelligence Specialist – Power BI & Business Central.

Job responsibilities

• Own, build and maintain Power BI dashboards and recurring management reports across finance, billing, procurement, quality control and operational KPIs.

• Produce P&L, balance sheet, and cost/profit‑centre reporting, and ensure the numbers are accurate at month‑end close – including identifying when data looks wrong, tracing it back to source, reconciling discrepancies, and working with ERP / IT stakeholders to resolve the root cause.

• Work with data drawn from multiple source systems (ERP, SQL, Excel and operational tools), understanding how those systems and tables relate to each other.

• Support and help improve the data flow between the ERP and Power BI, including reviewing the current export‑to‑SQL setup and where reporting can be made more live or more reliable.

• Integrate inspection/QC data from the factory inspection app into reporting outputs where needed.

• Partner directly with senior stakeholders – CEO, CFO, Procurement Director and Head of IT – to turn reporting needs into practical outputs.

• Support reporting for key business initiatives and management reviews.

Job requirements

• Strong, hands‑on Power BI experience – dashboard development, management/KPI reporting and recurring reports.

• Solid understanding of where data comes from: comfortable working across ERP systems, SQL and Excel, and able to understand the relationships between data sources.

• A genuine eye for data accuracy and reconciliation – able to tell when reported numbers are wrong and fix the root cause, not just rebuild the chart.

• Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience is strongly preferred (internal ERP support is available, but ERP/data familiarity matters here).

• Strong Excel; SQL useful.

• Able to work independently in a lean environment and communicate with senior, non‑technical stakeholders.

• Experience in finance, supply chain, procurement, manufacturing or sourcing reporting is an advantage.

Why you should join them

• You own the BI function rather than sitting inside a large team – your work goes straight to the CEO and CFO.

• Real scope to improve things: the reporting setup has known gaps, and you'll be the person who fixes how the business sees its data.

• Direct, regular access to senior leadership and exposure to how a global sourcing business actually runs – from procurement to finance to quality.

• A stable, established company with a global footprint, building out this capability locally – so there's room to shape the role.

Build

This leading Retail organisation are looking to appoint a Business Intelligence/Power BI Analyst to support their finance function in developing Dashboards and Power BI Reports to support senior management decisioning and automate processes. Your primary focus turning data from multiple sources into clear, actionable insights for the business in Power BI.

Client Details

Leading Retail organisation

Description

This leading Retail organisation are looking to appoint a Business Intelligence/Power BI Analyst to support their finance function in developing Dashboards and Power BI Reports to support senior management decisioning and automate processes. Your primary focus turning data from multiple sources into clear, actionable insights for the business in Power BI. You will also provide ongoing support and training to end users, ensuring they can confidently and effectively use Power BI reporting solutions.

Alongside this core reporting focus, you will design, build and support automation tools (an interest in learning and developing skills in Power Automate/Power Apps is desirable) that improve business workflows. Working closely with Finance, over time you will help develop approval processes, identify automation opportunities, and support continuous process improvement through practical AI and automation solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
• Collaborating with stakeholders to gather and understand business requirements, ensuring alignment with business goals
• Ensuring deliverables are completed to specification, and within agreed timelines
• Implementing best practices for data visualisation and report design to enhance user experience and data comprehension
• Create and maintain data models to ensure efficient performance and accurate data representation
• Transform raw data from multiple sources (databases, APIs, Excel, etc.) into meaningful and visually appealing reports
• Optimise Power BI reports and dashboards for performance, ensuring fast load times and responsiveness
• Monitoring and maintaining data quality and integrity across all reports and dashboards
• Conducting regular reviews and updates of PowerBI reports and dashboards to ensure they meet evolving business needs
• Support the business with automation and developing workflows through suitable automation platforms
• Work closely with Finance teams to identify reporting, control and process automation opportunities
• Training and supporting end-users to effectively utilise PowerBI and other tools/reports
• Staying updated with the latest PowerBI features and automation trends to continuously improve automation and reporting capabilities

Profile
• Proven experience as a BI Developer, Power BI Developer, automation specialist or similar role.
• Strong proficiency in Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, and Power Query.
• Solid understanding of data modelling concepts, including star schema, relationships, and normalisation.
• Experience with DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) for creating complex measures and calculations
• Familiarity with Power BI best practices, security, and sharing capabilities.
• Proficient in SQL and experience with querying databases (SQL Server, Oracle, etc.).
• Knowledge of ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and tools.
• Analytical thinker/problem solver
• Keen to learn and understand what is available in the market to support the business with automation
• Be proactive in flagging new tools and automation opportunities and willingness to explore the opportunities for the business.
• Ability to manage time and prioritise workloads based on urgency and importance with minimal supervision
• Willingness to see through complicated issues to resolution
• Structured and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on data accuracy, reconciliation and auditability
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working with finance teams
• Finance background or prior experience supporting Finance reporting/processes is required; experience in multi-department environments is a plus
• Experience building and supporting automation solutions is a plus. As an organisation we are keen to develop automation. We are looking for someone who is keen to develop their own skills in this area and support the business in their journey to automation of processes
